### People of Principle
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-january-3-2024.html
Passage: Daniel 1:15
Points:
- Daniel and his friends were placed in a hostile culture that attempted to reshape their identities.
- Although Babylon changed their names and circumstances, it could not compromise their hearts.
- Daniel refused the royal food and wine because he prioritized unbroken fellowship with God.
- Standing firm on principle in smaller daily matters prepared them to withstand major trials later.

### Choosing Faithfulness
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-may-3-2006-1394726.html
Passage: Daniel 1:8
Points:
- Daniel faced severe cultural upheaval in exile, yet established a clear boundary against defilement.
- Modern believers face similar pressures through endless demands competing for their time and focus.
- Faithfulness requires intentionally drawing boundaries and rejecting influences that pull us from God.
- Investing in God's priorities rather than cultural conformity brings His lasting blessing.
